Specifically, C7 should pass when the settlement includes any commitment (regardless of type — board_update, track_parts, load_test, or other) whose detail text mentions both "1400" (or "1400 parts delivery") and either "maintenance board" or "board" or "documented" or "entered" or "cited" or "tracked." This loosening does NOT risk a LEAKED regression because a lone decision-maker without PF1 would not know the 1400 delivery time to include in any commitment — the 1400 time is private to A2 (PF1 owner) and is not in shared_context, so only settlements that actually used PF1's revelation would contain it.
